## Description

Holds a spot/perpetual hedge or offsets perpetual contracts to collect positive funding while targeting low directional exposure.

## Where it may fit

Persistent positive funding with liquid hedges and stable collateral; can reverse during selloffs or crowded positioning.

## Vehicles

Crypto market-neutral funds and specialist digital-asset trading books.

## Required data

Perpetual funding rates and timestamps, spot/perpetual prices, order books, fees, margin, borrow and liquidation parameters.

## Caveats

Funding is variable, not guaranteed; liquidation mechanics, basis divergence, exchange/custody risk and funding interval differences are critical.
